descriptions.d24l_textbox_open_802c2aac: Opens a text box: resets it (0x802c2c10), loads the 'FE.Textbox.Back' mesh by name with resource type base+28 into a temporary handle, casts it (0x8034357c) and stores it retained at +48 releasing the previous mesh, sets its scale (500,500,1) through virtual slot +84, sets colour (254,234,213,0) with 0x80173df0, runs the layout and caption routines, dispatches focus state 1 for index +64, sets up the cursor and marks the box ready at +80.
